gttweaks.configuration.title: GregTech Tweaks Configuration
Scroll-wheel zoom speed in multiblock previews, as a multiple of ModularUI's step (1/12 block per notch). 1.0 is ModularUI's speed; the default is 10.0.
gttweaks.machine.rs.item_import.tooltip: §bKeeps the configured items stocked from a Refined Storage network
gttweaks.machine.rs.item_export.tooltip: §bSends the multiblock's item results to a Refined Storage network
gttweaks.machine.rs.fluid_import.tooltip: §bKeeps the configured fluids stocked from a Refined Storage network
gttweaks.machine.rs.fluid_export.tooltip: §bSends the multiblock's fluid results to a Refined Storage network
gttweaks.machine.rs.item_stocking.toolti: §bShows the network's items to the multiblock and takes them only when a recipe runs
gttweaks.machine.rs.pattern_buffer_proxy: §bLends a Pattern Buffer elsewhere to this multiblock
§bLink it to a buffer with a data stick; each proxy earns the buffer another slot
gttweaks.machine.rs.pattern_buffer.toolt: §bHolds Refined Storage patterns and receives their ingredients when the network crafts
§bEach pattern fills its own slot, and a recipe is satisfied from one slot alone
gttweaks.machine.rs.fluid_stocking.toolt: §bShows the network's fluids to the multiblock and takes them only when a recipe runs
